replies.author: Legoche
replies.body:
I am sorry to say but your map, Pony Lands II, has been denied from testing for the Avicus Network.


To Improve your map, the map developers suggest that you remove the first void gap and extend the land below the mountain. We also suggest that one of the back monuments is moved.

If you have any other questions on how to improve your map, message me on Skype (downfallgaming123)

You may resubmit your map once edited.
